title: eucalyptus parvula
intro: Eucalyptus parvula, commonly known as the dwarf eucalyptus or small-fruited mallee, is a small tree or shrub native to Western Australia. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, and ease cold and flu symptoms due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Eucalyptus parvula include decongestant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its use in aromatherapy and traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Eucalyptus parvula include eucalyptol, a primary active compound responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other volatile oils and flavonoids.
